dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.adapt.getAdapterToAdaptersAdapt>
<!description: Replace IAdaptable.getAdapter(Class) with org.eclipse.core.runtime.Adapters.adapt(IAdaptable, Class) for safer adaptation.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: eclipse, modernization>

$element.getAdapter($Type.class) :: instanceof($element, "org.eclipse.core.runtime.IAdaptable")
=> org.eclipse.core.runtime.Adapters.adapt($element, $Type.class)
;;
summary: Replace calls to `IAdaptable.getAdapter` with `org.eclipse.core.runtime.Adapters.adapt` for improved safety and consistency, especially in Eclipse platforms.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
